Context: 10. Guidelines for issue of medicines to CGHS beneficiaries from CGHS Wellness Centres

- (f) Medicines can be issued for up to 6 months, for those CGHS beneficiaries, going abroad. - OM, dated 21-10-2014.  
The CMO in-charge of the concerned CGHS Wellness Centre shall permit issue of OPD medicines subject to submission of the  
following:-  
- (i) Copy of valid CGHS Card
- (ii)
- (iii)
- Valid prescription for six months
- Documentary proof of going abroad like ticket, visa, etc.
- OM, dated 19-8-2019.
